create.name: Zen Centrum Nijmegen
create.bio:
Zen Centrum Nijmegen is a lay Zen community on the wooded edge of Nijmegen, meeting in a zendo beside the Museumpark Orientalis in Heilig Landstichting. It was set up in 2010 by Dick Verstegen, a former journalist who had already started a Zen group near Eindhoven. He trained with Rients Ritskes and then with Nico Tydeman of Zen Centrum Amsterdam, who ordained him and gave him Dharma transmission in the White Plum lineage; he received inka in 2024 under the name Benji and has written six books on Zen. A small team of other teachers leads groups alongside him, and the centre describes its approach as Zen from the heart, open to art, science, ecology and other faiths.

Newcomers begin with a starter course of seven evening sessions on zazen, zendo customs and basic Zen thought, then join one of the weekly groups, which follow a yearly cycle of themes with the Heart Sutra, sitting, walking meditation, a short interactive talk and a tea ceremony. There are silent Sunday mornings twice a month, monthly one-to-one conversations with Dick, study days on classic texts, and silent retreats of one, three or five days. The small YouTube channel holds talks, a conversation with Nico Tydeman and short films about the sangha.

courses.title: Starterstraject zen
courses.description: A beginners' course of seven Tuesday-evening sessions, plus an optional eighth in a regular group, covering sitting meditation, the customs of the zendo and the first principles of Zen thought; open to people with little or no Zen experience.

courses.title: Studieklas – Mahamudra
courses.description: A one-day study class on Tilopa's Song of Mahamudra, combining meditation, slow contemplative reading, group discussion and conversation in pairs about how the text speaks to each participant.
courses.price: Donatiesuggestie € 45,– voor leden en € 75,– voor gasten

courses.title: Stille zondag – 3e zondag v/d maand
courses.description: A silent Sunday morning with the Heart Sutra, three periods of zazen with walking meditation, and a closing tea ceremony and bodhisattva vows; open to non-members with some zazen experience.

courses.title: Dana Daisan
courses.description: A monthly Sunday morning when people can ask for a personal conversation with Dick Benji Roshi about Zen practice or wider questions of life.

courses.title: Retraites of sesshins
courses.description: Silent retreats of one, three or five days with zazen, sutra chanting, private interviews, Dharma talks, work practice and garden sitting, plus one-day Zen Saturdays as a taste of a longer sesshin.

flags: Thin channel: 53 subscribers and 13 videos, mostly short; 7 videos chosen, two of them book trailers. Latest upload Feb 2026.
Base: the zendo is at Profetenlaan 2, Heilig Landstichting (municipality of Berg en Dal, beside Nijmegen), from the contact page.
Two chosen videos are guest lectures (Hans Korteweg; Michel Dijkstra), neither on Spiritpedia.

Teachers Dick Verstegen (Benji Roshi), Maarten Jurgens, Meike Oosterwijk, Janneke Robben and Misha Beliën (Yushin sensei) are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. Dick Verstegen's six Dutch books were not looked up (Amazon not fetched).
White Plum lineage (Bernie Glassman / Maezumi line) via Nico Tydeman; no allegations about current teachers found on the site.
Photo 1 is a portrait of the founding teacher from the site; photo 2 the logo avatar.
